name: de-ruins-minimap-de
description: The editor's DE mode (we-drive --mode de) on de-ruins.w3x (make-shadow-probes.mjs: EW00, ET00, EMt0 whose models only the 3.0 art layer has, LRrk, a Grass Cliff plateau), File > Calculate Shadows and Save Map; Studio with game.graphicsMode de: Calculate Shadows, rebuild_map. MATCH (2026-11-22): the DE minimap takes the ground's and cliffs' colours from the 3.0 layer's own _Diffuse textures (_DE.w3mod: Lords_Dirt 148, 108, 60 near the Classic 145, 104, 60, so the ground alone looked Classic; Lords_Cliff1 66, 100, 41 against Classic 96, 124, 66 and HD 79, 113, 33), the doodads their DE models' colours. The verify round's '327 blocks off' was Studio in HD against the editor in DE. minimapgen.ts hdFirst. The same save's war3map.shd differs in 5 cells, EMt0's (docs/testing/lighting-and-shadows.md), so it isn't compared here

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
